title: BC Workflow
description: Schema for workflow.json files used by Run-BCWorkflow.ps1 to orchestrate multi-user Business Central test sequences.

$schema.description: Optional: reference to this schema file for VS Code IntelliSense.

name.description: Human-readable name for the workflow. Shown in report output.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what the workflow tests.
examples: Multi-user workflow: Purchaser creates PO, Approver approves it

bc_url.description: The Business Central environment URL. Found in your BC browser address bar up to and including the environment name segment.

steps.description: Ordered list of workflow steps. Each step runs as a specific user and can capture values to pass to later steps.

step.description: A single workflow step — one YAML script (or a set of scripts) executed as a named user role.

id.description: Unique identifier for this step. Used in depends_on and capture expression references. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only.

name.description: Human-readable name for this step. Shown in the report.

user.description: The role key that maps to a user entry in users.json. Must match a top-level key in users.json.

script.description: Relative path to a single YAML script file. Use either 'script' OR 'scripts', not both.

scripts.description: List of YAML script files to run in sequence for this step. Use either 'script' OR 'scripts', not both.

items.description: Relative path to a YAML script file.

depends_on.description: Step 'id' that must complete successfully before this step runs. Use when inject references a capture from another step.

capture.description: Values to capture from the BC page after this step runs. The key is a variable name you choose; the value is 'Page Title - Field Caption' as it appears in BC. Captured values are available to later steps via {capture.stepId.varName}.

additionalProperties.description: The BC field identifier in the format 'Page Title - Field Caption'.

inject.description: Field values to inject into this step's YAML script before running. The key is 'PageTitle.FieldCaption' (dot-separated, matching the YAML field target); the value is a capture expression using the syntax {capture.stepId.varName}.
